short_statement: Department must not exceed approved headcount
All employees complete COC-100 every 12 months
All employees complete DPA-110 every 12 months
HR starts leaver checklist on resignation (HR systems only); managers reassign duties in other systems
Support hiring freeze until 2027-03-31; exceptions need COO and Head of Finance
Committed spend must not exceed approved budget line
PO approver limit must be at least the PO amount
Product spend above 40,000 GBP also needs the product's accountable senior manager
Supplier due diligence complete before first PO approval
Each payments product holds a current unexpired Legal approval
Only staff with valid PCT-101 may sell or onboard
Customer payment data processed and stored only in UK or EEA, including sub-processors
Complaints procedure documented and reviewed annually
Premium tier: 24x7 support, two agents at all times, 15-minute first response
Notify regulator 5 business days before launching a new payments feature
Material changes need Legal re-approval before release
Active supplier contracts must not be past end date
Each product has a named accountable senior manager who is available
DPA signed before a supplier processes customer data
